insights.one_liner: Schiedam-based heavy lifting and transport specialist owned by SHV, an IND recognised sponsor with English-language roles.

culture.text: Lifts, moves, installs and dismantles very large structures for petrochemical, construction, offshore and energy clients worldwide.
Headquartered in Schiedam and founded in 1973.
Recent projects include installing a 2,200-tonne railway bridge in Budapest.
culture.source: Heavy Lift & Project Forwarding International, 6 Oct 2026

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through Mammoet Europe B.V., Mammoet Europe Holding B.V. and Mammoet Holding B.V.

growth.text: Owned by Dutch SHV Holdings, which again failed to sell Mammoet, citing unfavourable market conditions.
Completed what it calls the world's first fully electric monopile transport in real-world conditions.
Became the first in its industry to get ISO 19443 nuclear power certification.

worth_knowing.text: Owner SHV tried to sell Mammoet but the sale fell through again, so ownership could change in future.
COO and former CEO Jan Kleijn is leaving after 30 years at the company.
